interaction_framework.rule: Interaction occurs when an adventurer or party encounters a creature or group not previously encountered.
The first exchange is an initial_interaction resolved with an interaction_roll.
If the adventurer or party wants to change an existing attitude, they must make an attempt_to_influence.
If combat breaks out, no attempts_to_influence may be made until the adventurer or party is defeated and captured, or the opposing creatures are defeated or fail a morale roll.

definitions.entry: Creature attempts to withdraw or escape at the first opportunity; if no opportunity exists, it counts as cowed while it remains intimidated.
Creature acts as if Friendly while it remains intimidated.
Fearful and Cowed creatures are treated as Neutral for purposes of diplomatic or seductive interactions.

time_required.rule: Interaction time increases as the parties become more established in their relationship or opposition.

spokesperson_rules.rule: When groups interact, each group designates a spokesperson.
The spokesperson is typically the group's leader or highest Charisma character.
The spokesperson's class, ability scores, proficiencies, and other relevant characteristics apply on behalf of the group.
If the party has no agreed spokesperson, the first adventurer encountered by or speaking to the other side is the spokesperson for that stage.
If it is unclear who speaks first, the Judge may call for an initiative roll to determine it.

tone.name: diplomatic
tone.definition: Non-threatening appeal to the self-interest of the target or target's group.

tone.name: intimidating
tone.definition: Threat to cause harm to the target or target's group if they do not cooperate.

tone.name: seductive
tone.definition: Interaction resolved using the seduction modifiers and reaction table.

interaction_tones.rule: If a party is surprised by an encounter, the Judge chooses the tone least favorable to the party.
Otherwise, the party's spokesperson chooses the tone for the initial interaction and for each later stage.
If the tone is unclear from statements or roleplay, the Judge may ask for clarification or decide the adopted tone.
Once the tone is settled, the Judge makes an interaction roll.

diplomatic_interactions.definition: Diplomatic interaction is a non-threatening appeal to the target's self-interest.

intimidating_interactions.definition: Intimidating interaction is a threat of harm if the target does not cooperate.
intimidating_interactions.rule: Intimidating interactions cannot achieve genuinely Indifferent or Friendly attitudes.
In intimidating interactions, Indifferent is replaced by Fearful and Friendly is replaced by Cowed.
Attitudes established by intimidating interactions are temporary.
New interactions with newly encountered allies are rolled separately, and that roll may also shift the attitudes of creatures already intimidated if the changed circumstances weaken the intimidation.
When a character intimidates new allies of creatures already intimidated, make a new interaction roll for the new allies.
If the new allies receive a worse intimidation result than the already-intimidated creatures, the already-intimidated creatures' attitudes also worsen to match the change in circumstances.
For the already-intimidated creatures, resolve this as an attempt_to_influence using the same roll result generated for the newly encountered allies.
Apply the result as an attitude shift from their current intimidation attitude rather than assigning a fresh initial attitude.
The new interaction with new allies should be resolved using the same roll used for the initial interaction with those new creatures.
The Judge may call for a new interaction roll any time the conditions that led to the initial intimidation materially change.
Lengthy ongoing intimidation attempts represent long-term brainwashing, dehumanizing treatment, or torture.
The Judge may limit the use of such long-term intimidating interactions by Lawful characters.

procedure.name: resolve_interaction
procedure.step: Determine whether the encounter is an initial_interaction or an attempt_to_influence an existing attitude.
Apply relevant modifiers for the chosen tone.
For an initial_interaction, assign the resulting attitude from the relevant reaction table.
For an attempt_to_influence, shift attitude the listed number of steps toward the indicated destination.
Require the listed time interval before the next attempt_to_influence.

confidence_notes.note: The seduction modifiers table appears to contain an OCR/layout duplication and one likely corruption. The line for older age category appears twice with the same positive modifier, and the behavioral traits lines appear inverted in the source image-text flow. I normalized them to an internally consistent mechanical reading, but those lines should be checked against the original layout for exact wording.

The intimidation rule stating that encounters with new allies should be resolved with the same roll as that used for the initial interaction is preserved as written, but the intended meaning may be that the same intimidating circumstances or same rolled result applies. Source wording should be checked if exact procedural intent matters.
